messages:
Maria: ran the sample-app soak test and hit duplicate webhook deliveries. looks like client retried identical POSTs on 429s.

Leo: which SDK and retry settings? if there's no Idempotency-Key retries will replay side-effectful calls.

Maria: sdk-py 0.9.0, default retry. sample config: 
```
retry: { max_attempts: 5, base_ms: 200, jitter: 0.0, strategy: exp }
include_idempotency: false
```

ci-bot: infra: rate-limit changes deployed to us-central (burst tightened) 2026-03-18T17:04Z

Kisey: two small but important rules: 1) always honor Retry-After if present; 2) use decorrelated jitter (per AWS nic) to avoid thundering herd. e.g. sleep = min(cap, random_between(base, prev_sleep * 3))

Devon: also recommend time-window cap (total_retry_time <= 20s) and a clear 'RetriesExhausted' error. SDK should expose last_attempts and last_backoff in error metadata.

Leo: API side: we'll add explicit guidance in response when a retry is safe vs unsafe (header: X-Retry-Safe: true/false). SDK can read it to decide.

Maria: for sample-app demo: updated pattern idea: generate idempotency key helper and default to adding one for create-type flows when demo harness enabled. show toggle in UI with WARN.

Kisey: also add integration test that simulates 429 with Retry-After and asserts webhook got a single delivery when Idempotency-Key present.

Leo: i'll implement SDK change: - respect Retry-After precedence - switch to decorrelated jitter - do not auto-retry non-idempotent endpoints unless Idempotency-Key is present or unsafeReplay=true (opt-in, false by default). will feature-flag for one release.

Devon: i'll handle sample-app and docs updates once the SDK PR lands. add a small `devx retry-inspector` CLI to simulate server Retry-After behavior for debugging.

Maria: thanks folks :thumbsup:

ci-bot: pr-tracker: leo/sdk-retry-decorrelated opened PR #4251 (CI running).
